reason: The cited evidence (E1) evaluates VFeTiTaW as a standalone thermal barrier, not as an interlayer in a W–Cu composite. It reports greater phase growth (lower microstructural stability) for VFeTiTaW and provides no data on interfacial bonding, phonon transmission, thermal boundary resistance reduction, thermal conductivity enhancement, or mechanical durability. The claim of lower deuterium retention is incomplete in the provided text. Thus, the key premises are unsupported by the cited passage.
premises: VFeTiTaW interlayer improves interfacial bonding and facilitates phonon transmission across W–Cu interface
VFeTiTaW has intrinsic microstructural stability under annealing and irradiation
VFeTiTaW shows lower deuterium retention, indicating irradiation resistance
The interlayer reduces thermal boundary resistance, enhancing thermal conductivity
